 Jang Sun-hee Reporter 입력 2026.11.06 00:27 
 [Image=JKN] 
 On November 5, 2026 (local time), Tesla shares dropped 9.43% to close at $348.85 on Wall Street, falling $36.34 on the session. The sharp decline accompanied broader weakness across technology and semiconductor equities alongside intensifying sector competition.
 Shares of Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) retreated sharply during trading on November 5, 2026, ending the session down $36.34, or 9.43%, at $348.85.
 The downturn occurred amid a broader decline across technology and semiconductor equities, which weighed on growth-oriented assets. Related market reports also noted broader losses intensifying among artificial intelligence names that did not participate in recent market advances, alongside developments surrounding political challenges in Texas affecting executive leadership.
 The decline also coincided with competitive shifts within the emerging robotics landscape. Market attention turned to the robotics sector as Agility Robotics, a developer competing directly with Tesla's Optimus humanoid program, began public trading following a special purpose acquisition company transaction.
 This entrance added a fresh dynamic to investor scrutiny regarding commercialization timelines and leadership in autonomous systems and physical artificial intelligence.
 Broader market risks and valuation dynamics continue to influence trading sentiment across the automotive and technology spaces. High-multiple growth equities remain particularly sensitive to macroeconomic shifts, competitive pressures, and changing industry fundamentals.
 In an environment where technology names face intermittent sell-offs, market participants often weigh extended valuations against potential operational hurdles, supply chain variables, and the capital expenditure demands required for next-generation initiatives.
 From a market positioning standpoint, today's drop places the equity under renewed downward pressure following previous consolidations. Market observers will be monitoring whether the stock can establish firm technical support near its recent trading range or if broader tech sector softness will prolong the correction toward lower support zones.
 Conversely, any stabilization will likely require sustained buying interest to reclaim recent resistance thresholds.
